question: Which edition of the Khelo India University Games was held in Uttar Pradesh in 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**3rd Edition**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Khelo India University Games (KIUG)** is a flagship initiative of the Government of India under the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, aimed at promoting sports culture among university students.
 
• The **3rd edition** of the Khelo India University Games was held in **Uttar Pradesh** in 2023</strong
